does_not_prove: A re-review bound to the new bytes proves the current text was seen by a second party. It does not prove the edit itself was a good idea.
prediction_prompt: After promotion, someone silently fixed a typo in the canon file. The review receipt still records the old hash. Which diagnostics should fire?
spec_must: SPEC.md section 10: a review MUST be bound to the exact bytes it reviewed; editing reviewed bytes voids the review, the freeze, and the promotion binding.
title: Silent edit after review
